# DomainTools

> DomainTools is the global leader in DNS-based threat intelligence, providing visibility into over 97% of internet infrastructure. The platform helps security teams detect, investigate, and block malicious domains through passive DNS data, risk scoring, and guided pivot analysis across interconnected threat infrastructure.

DomainTools maps virtually the entire internet to identify and predict threats. Its products — Iris Investigate, Iris Detect, and Iris Enrich — enable threat hunting, brand monitoring, fraud prevention, and incident response. The platform integrates with all major SOC tools including SIEMs, SOARs, and TIPs. DomainTools also maintains DNSDB, the world's largest passive DNS database with over a decade of historical DNS resolution data.

## Platform

- [Platform Overview](https://www.domaintools.com/platform): Core capabilities including Iris Investigate, Iris Detect, Iris Enrich, and DNSDB passive DNS
- [Threat Intelligence Feeds](https://www.domaintools.com/feeds): Predictive risk scoring and domain visibility data feeds
- [Domain Research](https://www.domaintools.com/products/domain-research): Whois lookup, reverse Whois, and domain history tools
- [Pricing](https://www.domaintools.com/products/pricing): Plans and pricing for domain research tools
- [Platform Benefits](https://www.domaintools.com/benefits): Key advantages of the DomainTools platform
- [Request a Demo](https://www.domaintools.com/demo): Schedule a personalized platform demonstration

## Integrations

- [Integrations Overview](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations): All supported security platform integrations
- [Splunk](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/splunk): Splunk SIEM integration
- [Splunk SOAR](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/splunk-soar): Splunk SOAR automation integration
- [Microsoft Sentinel](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/microsoft-sentinel): Microsoft Sentinel integration
- [CrowdStrike](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/crowdstrike): CrowdStrike Falcon integration
- [IBM QRadar](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/ibm-qradar): IBM QRadar SIEM integration
- [Cortex XSOAR](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/cortex-xsoar): Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR integration
- [Maltego](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/maltego): Maltego visual link analysis integration
- [Elastic ELK Stack](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/elastic-elk-stack): Elastic SIEM integration
- [Google SOAR](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/google-soar): Google Chronicle SOAR integration
- [MISP](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/misp): Open-source threat intelligence platform integration
- [ServiceNow](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/servicenow): ServiceNow Security Operations integration
- [Rapid7](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/rapid7): Rapid7 InsightConnect integration
- [ThreatConnect](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/threatconnect): ThreatConnect TIP integration
- [Recorded Future](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/recorded-future): Recorded Future integration
- [TheHive and Cortex](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/thehive-and-cortex): TheHive incident response integration
- [Anomali](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/anomali): Anomali ThreatStream integration
- [EclecticIQ](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/eclecticiq): EclecticIQ threat intelligence integration
- [IBM Resilient](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/ibm-resilient): IBM Resilient SOAR integration
- [Exabeam](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/exabeam): Exabeam SIEM integration
- [ThreatQ](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/threatq): ThreatQ threat intelligence integration
- [Polarity](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/polarity): Polarity overlay integration
- [Tines](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/tines): Tines automation integration
- [Torq](https://www.domaintools.com/integrations/torq): Torq hyperautomation integration

## Documentation

- [API & Product Documentation](https://docs.domaintools.com/): Complete technical documentation, API references, and user guides
- [Iris Investigate User Guide](https://docs.domaintools.com/iris/investigate/userguide/): How to use Iris Investigate for threat analysis
- [Iris Detect](https://docs.domaintools.com/iris/): Iris Detect product documentation
- [DNSDB Documentation](https://docs.domaintools.com/dnsdb/): Passive DNS database documentation and search guides
- [DNSDB API Reference](https://docs.domaintools.com/api/dnsdb/userguide/): DNSDB API programmer documentation
- [Risk Score User Guide](https://docs.domaintools.com/riskscore/userguide/): Domain risk scoring methodology and usage
- [Changelog](https://docs.domaintools.com/changelog/): Product updates and release notes

## Resources

- [Resource Center](https://www.domaintools.com/resource-center): All resources including white papers, reports, webinars, and case studies
- [Blog](https://www.domaintools.com/resources/blog): Threat intelligence articles, research, and industry analysis
- [White Papers](https://www.domaintools.com/resources/white-papers): In-depth research and technical white papers
- [Case Studies](https://www.domaintools.com/resources/case-studies): Customer success stories and use cases
- [Survey Reports](https://www.domaintools.com/resources/survey-reports): Industry survey findings including annual threat hunting reports
- [DomainTools Reports](https://www.domaintools.com/resources/domaintools-reports): Original DomainTools research reports
- [Webinars](https://www.domaintools.com/resources/webinars): On-demand and upcoming webinars
- [Podcasts](https://www.domaintools.com/resources/podcasts): Breaking Badness podcast episodes on cybersecurity topics

## Threat Research

- [DomainTools Investigations](https://dti.domaintools.com): Threat research and intelligence from the DomainTools investigations team

## Company

- [About DomainTools](https://www.domaintools.com/company/about): Company background, mission, and leadership
- [Press](https://www.domaintools.com/company/press): Press releases and media coverage
- [Careers](https://www.domaintools.com/company/careers): Open positions at DomainTools
- [Partners](https://www.domaintools.com/partners): Partnership program information
- [Events](https://www.domaintools.com/events): Conferences and events where DomainTools participates
- [Contact](https://www.domaintools.com/contact): Contact sales, support, and general inquiries

## Optional

- [Newsletter Signup](https://www.domaintools.com/newsletter): Subscribe to the DomainTools newsletter
- [DTI Newsletter](https://www.domaintools.com/investigations-newsletter-reg): DomainTools Investigations newsletter registration
- [RSS Feed](https://www.domaintools.com/rss): RSS feed for blog and content updates
- [Search](https://www.domaintools.com/search): Site search
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.domaintools.com/policies/privacy-policy): Privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://www.domaintools.com/policies/terms-of-service): Terms of service
- [California Privacy Notice](https://www.domaintools.com/policies/california-privacy-notice): CCPA privacy notice
- [Do Not Sell](https://www.domaintools.com/policies/do-not-sell): Do not sell my personal information
- [Enterprise Subscription Agreement](https://www.domaintools.com/policies/enterprise-subscription-agreement): Enterprise licensing terms
- [Service Level Agreement](https://www.domaintools.com/policies/service-level-agreement): SLA details

.data-table th,

}

th,

/* ===================================
 BASE TABS STYLES
 =================================== */

/* Content visibility management */
.tabs_content_list>*:not(.w-dyn-list),
.tabs_content_list>.w-dyn-list>*>*>* {
  display: none;
}

/* Show first tab content by default */
.tabs_content_list> :first-child:not(.w-dyn-list),
.tabs_content_list>.w-dyn-list>*> :first-child>* {
  display: block;
}

/* Webflow design mode preview */
.wf-design-mode .tabs_wrap[data-preview-content="true"] .tabs_content_list>*:not(.w-dyn-list),
.wf-design-mode .tabs_wrap[data-preview-content="true"] .tabs_content_list>.w-dyn-list>*>*>* {
  display: block;
}

/* Dynamic list display handling */
:is(.tabs_content_list, .tabs_button_list)>.w-dyn-list,
:is(.tabs_content_list, .tabs_button_list)>.w-dyn-list>*,
:is(.tabs_content_list, .tabs_button_list)>.w-dyn-list>*>* {
  display: contents;
}

/* ===================================
 TAB BUTTONS
 =================================== */

/* Active tab button styles */
.tabs_button_item.is-active,
.wf-design-mode .tabs_button_list>.tabs_button_item:first-child,
.wf-design-mode .tabs_button_list>.w-dyn-list>*> :first-child>.tabs_button_item {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Tab button underline indicator */
.tabs_button_item.is-active .tabs_button_line,
.wf-design-mode .tabs_button_list>.tabs_button_item:first-child .tabs_button_line,
.wf-design-mode .tabs_button_list>.w-dyn-list>*> :first-child>.tabs_button_item .tabs_button_line {
  width: calc(100% * var(--progress, 1));
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Content transitions */
.tabs_content_item {
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.tabs_button_clip {
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows .3s cubic-bezier(0.61, 1, 0.88, 1);
}

.tabs_button_item.is-active .tabs_button_clip {
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;

}

.wf-design-mode .tabs_button_item .tabs_button_clip {
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;

}

/* ===================================
 DESKTOP ACCORDION MODE
 =================================== */

/* Accordion container borders */
.how_contain .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .accordion_item {
  border-bottom: 0px solid var(--_theme---border);
}

.how_contain .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .accordion_item:first-child {
  border-top: 0px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

}

/* Accordion button styles */
#tabs-hero .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_button_item {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;

}

.how_contain .tabs_wrap.is-accordion {
  grid-template-rows: 0.5rem !important;
}

/* Accordion toggle icon animation */
.tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_button_item .accordion-cms_toggle_icon {
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_button_item.is-active .accordion-cms_toggle_icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* Accordion content animation */
.tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_content_item {
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_content_item:not(.is-active) {
  height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
}

.tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_content_item.is-active {
  height: auto;
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Accordion content padding */

  padding: 1rem 0rem 0rem 0rem !important;
}

/* Hide tab controls in accordion mode */
.tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_control_button {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Hide accordion icons by default (desktop) */

  display: none;
}

/* ===================================
 MOBILE STYLES
 =================================== */

@media (max-width: 767px) {

#tabs-hero .tabs_button_title-wrap {
        grid-column-gap: 1rem;
        grid-row-gap: 1rem;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: start;
        display: flex;
    }

  /* Basic mobile tab layout */
  .tabs_button_list {
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .tabs_button_item {
    width: 100%;
  }

  /* Mobile accordion structure */
  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_button_wrap,
  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_content_wrap {

  }
  
  /* Show and animate arrow icon on mobile */
  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .accordion-cms_toggle_icon {

    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }

  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_button_item.is-active .accordion-cms_toggle_icon {
    transform: rotate(-180deg);
  }

  /* Mobile accordion content animation using CSS Grid */
  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_content_item {

  }

  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_content_item>* {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_content_item.is-active {
    grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  }

  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_button_line {
    display: none;
  }

  /* Hide tab controls on mobile accordion */
  .tabs_wrap.is-accordion .tabs_control_wrap {
    display: none;
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".tabs_wrap").forEach((tabWrap, componentIndex) => {
    if (tabWrap.dataset.scriptInitialized) return;
    tabWrap.dataset.scriptInitialized = "true";

    // Configuration
    let loopControls = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-loop-controls") === "true",
      slideTabs = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-slide-tabs") === "true",
      autoplay = Number(tabWrap.getAttribute("data-autoplay-duration")) || 0,
      duration = Number(tabWrap.getAttribute("data-duration")) || 0.3,
      convertAccordion = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-convert-accordion") === "true",
      allowMultiple = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-allow-multiple") === "true",
      buttonList = tabWrap.querySelector(".tabs_button_list"),
      panelList = tabWrap.querySelector(".tabs_content_list"),
      previousButton = tabWrap.querySelector("[data-tab='prev']"),
      nextButton = tabWrap.querySelector("[data-tab='next']"),
      animating = false,
      autoplayTl;

    // Accordion-specific variables
    const originalParent = buttonList.parentElement;
    const accordionItems = [];
    let isAccordion = false;

    function initCMSList(slot) {
      const dynList = Array.from(slot.children).find((child) => child.classList.contains("w-dyn-list"));
      if (!dynList) return;
      const nestedItems = dynList?.firstElementChild?.children;
      if (!nestedItems) return;
      const staticWrapper = [...slot.children];
      [...nestedItems].forEach(el => el.firstElementChild && slot.appendChild(el.firstElementChild));
      staticWrapper.forEach((el) => el.remove());
    }
    initCMSList(buttonList);
    initCMSList(panelList);

    let buttonItems = Array.from(buttonList.children);
    let panelItems = Array.from(panelList.children);

    if (!buttonList || !panelList || !buttonItems.length || !panelItems.length) {
      console.warn("Missing elements in:", tabWrap);
      return;
    }

    // Initialize ARIA attributes
    panelItems.forEach((panel, i) => {
      panel.style.display = "none";
      panel.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
    });
    buttonItems.forEach((button, i) => {
      button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
    });

    panelList.removeAttribute("role");
    buttonList.setAttribute("role", "tablist");

    let activeIndex = 0;

    // Tab functionality
    const initTabActive = (index, focus = false, animate = true, pause = true) => {
      if (animating || isAccordion) return;

      buttonItems.forEach((btn, i) => {
        btn.classList.toggle("is-active", i === index);
        btn.setAttribute("aria-selected", i === index ? "true" : "false");
        btn.setAttribute("tabindex", i === index ? "0" : "-1");
      });
      panelItems.forEach((panel, i) => panel.classList.toggle("is-active", i === index));

      if (typeof ScrollTrigger !== "undefined") ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      if (nextButton) nextButton.disabled = index === buttonItems.length - 1 && !loopControls;
      if (previousButton) previousButton.disabled = index === 0 && !loopControls;
      if (focus) buttonItems[index].focus();

      const previousPanel = panelItems[activeIndex];
      const currentPanel = panelItems[index];
      let direction = 1;
      if (activeIndex > index) direction = -1;

      // GSAP animations
      if (typeof gsap !== "undefined" && animate && activeIndex !== index) {
        if (autoplayTl && typeof autoplayTl.restart === "function") {
          autoplayTl.restart();
          if (pause) {
            autoplayTl.progress(0);
            autoplayTl.pause();
            gsap.set(tabWrap, { "--progress": 1 });
          }
        }
        animating = true;
        let tl = gsap.timeline({
          onComplete: () => animating = false,
          defaults: { duration: duration, ease: "power1.out" }
        });

        if (slideTabs) {
          tl.set(currentPanel, { display: "block", position: "relative" });
          if (previousPanel) tl.set(previousPanel, { position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, width: "100%" });
          if (previousPanel) tl.fromTo(previousPanel, { xPercent: 0 }, { xPercent: -120 * direction });
          tl.fromTo(currentPanel, { xPercent: 120 * direction }, { xPercent: 0 }, "<");
          if (previousPanel) tl.set(previousPanel, { display: "none" });
        } else {
          if (previousPanel) tl.to(previousPanel, { opacity: 0 });
          if (previousPanel) tl.set(previousPanel, { display: "none" });
          tl.set(currentPanel, { display: "block" });
          tl.fromTo(currentPanel, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 });
        }
      } else {
        if (previousPanel) previousPanel.style.display = "none";
        if (currentPanel) currentPanel.style.display = "block";
      }

      buttonList.scrollTo({ left: buttonItems[index].offsetLeft, behavior: 'smooth' });
      activeIndex = index;
    };

    // Accordion toggle functionality
    const initAccordionToggle = (index) => {
      const button = buttonItems[index];
      const panel = panelItems[index];
      const isActive = button.classList.contains("is-active");

      if (!allowMultiple) {
        buttonItems.forEach((btn, i) => {
          if (i !== index) {
            btn.classList.remove("is-active");
            btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            panelItems[i].classList.remove("is-active");
          }
        });
      }

      button.classList.toggle("is-active");
      panel.classList.toggle("is-active");
      button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", !isActive);

      if (typeof ScrollTrigger !== "undefined") ScrollTrigger.refresh();
    };

    // Transform to accordion
    const initAccordionTransform = () => {
      if (isAccordion) return;
      isAccordion = true;
      tabWrap.classList.add("is-accordion");

      if (autoplayTl) {
        autoplayTl.pause();
        gsap.set(tabWrap, { "--progress": 1 });
      }

      buttonItems.forEach((button, index) => {
        const panel = panelItems[index];
        const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
        wrapper.className = "accordion_item";

        const contentInner = document.createElement("div");
        contentInner.className = "accordion_content_inner";

        while (panel.firstChild) {
          contentInner.appendChild(panel.firstChild);
        }
        panel.appendChild(contentInner);

        panel.style.display = "";
        panel.style.opacity = "";
        panel.style.position = "";
        panel.style.transform = "";

        const isCurrentlyActive = index === activeIndex;
        button.classList.toggle("is-active", isCurrentlyActive);
        panel.classList.toggle("is-active", isCurrentlyActive);

        // Update ARIA for accordion
        button.setAttribute("role", "button");
        button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", isCurrentlyActive ? "true" : "false");
        button.removeAttribute("aria-selected");
        button.removeAttribute("tabindex");
        panel.removeAttribute("role");
        panel.removeAttribute("aria-labelledby"); // Remove prohibited attribute

        wrapper.appendChild(button);
        wrapper.appendChild(panel);
        accordionItems.push(wrapper);

        if (index === 0) {
          originalParent.appendChild(wrapper);
        } else {
          accordionItems[index - 1].after(wrapper);
        }
      });

      buttonList.style.display = "none";
      panelList.style.display = "none";

      if (typeof ScrollTrigger !== "undefined") ScrollTrigger.refresh();
    };

    // Transform back to tabs
    const initTabsTransform = () => {
      if (!isAccordion) return;
      isAccordion = false;
      tabWrap.classList.remove("is-accordion");

      const activeStates = buttonItems.map(btn => btn.classList.contains("is-active"));
      const firstActiveIndex = activeStates.findIndex(state => state);
      if (firstActiveIndex !== -1) activeIndex = firstActiveIndex;

      accordionItems.forEach((wrapper, index) => {
        const button = buttonItems[index];
        const panel = panelItems[index];
        const contentInner = panel.querySelector(".accordion_content_inner");

        if (contentInner) {
          while (contentInner.firstChild) {
            panel.appendChild(contentInner.firstChild);
          }
          contentInner.remove();
        }

        panel.style.display = "none";

        // Update ARIA for tabs
        button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
        button.setAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
        button.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
        button.removeAttribute("aria-expanded");
        panel.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
        panel.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", button.id); // Restore attribute

        buttonList.appendChild(button);
        panelList.appendChild(panel);

        wrapper.remove();
      });

      accordionItems.length = 0;

      buttonList.style.display = "";
      panelList.style.display = "";

      animating = false;
      initTabActive(activeIndex, false, false);

      if (autoplayTl && autoplay !== 0 && !isAccordion) {
        autoplayTl.play();
      }
    };

    // Check viewport and transform
    const initViewportCheck = () => {
      if (!convertAccordion) return;

      const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
      if (isMobile && !isAccordion) {
        initAccordionTransform();
      } else if (!isMobile && isAccordion) {
        initTabsTransform();
      }
    };

    initTabActive(0, false, false);

    const updateIndex = (delta, focus = false, pause = true) => {
      initTabActive((activeIndex + delta + buttonItems.length) % buttonItems.length, focus, true, pause);
    };

    nextButton?.addEventListener("click", () => updateIndex(1));
    previousButton?.addEventListener("click", () => updateIndex(-1));

    buttonItems.forEach((btn, index) => {
      let tabId = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-tab-component-id");
      tabId = tabId ? tabId.toLowerCase().replaceAll(" ", "-") : componentIndex + 1;
      let itemId = btn.getAttribute("data-tab-item-id");
      itemId = itemId ? itemId.toLowerCase().replaceAll(" ", "-") : index + 1;

      btn.setAttribute("id", "tab-button-" + tabId + "-" + itemId);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-controls", "tab-panel-" + tabId + "-" + itemId);
      panelItems[index].setAttribute("id", "tab-panel-" + tabId + "-" + itemId);
      panelItems[index].setAttribute("aria-labelledby", btn.id);

      if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("tab-id") === tabId + "-" + itemId) {
        initTabActive(index);
        autoplay = 0;
        tabWrap.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
        history.replaceState({}, "", ((u) => (u.searchParams.delete("tab-id"), u))(new URL(location.href)));
      }

      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (isAccordion) {
          initAccordionToggle(index);
        } else {
          initTabActive(index);
        }
      });

      btn.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (isAccordion) {
          if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
            e.preventDefault();
            initAccordionToggle(index);
          }
        } else {
          if (["ArrowRight", "ArrowDown"].includes(e.key)) updateIndex(1, true);
          else if (["ArrowLeft", "ArrowUp"].includes(e.key)) updateIndex(-1, true);
        }
      });

          onComplete: () => updateIndex(1, false, false),
          "--progress": 1,
          ease: "none",
          duration: autoplay
        });

      let isHovered = false,
        hasFocusInside = false,
        prefersReducedMotion = false,
        inView = true;

      function updateAuto() {
        if (prefersReducedMotion || !inView || isHovered || hasFocusInside || isAccordion) {
          autoplayTl.pause();
        } else {
          autoplayTl.play();
        }
      }

      function handleMotionChange(e) {
        prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
        updateAuto();
      }

      handleMotionChange(window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)"));
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").addEventListener("change", handleMotionChange);

      tabWrap.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => { isHovered = true; updateAuto() });
      tabWrap.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { hasFocusInside = false; isHovered = false; updateAuto() });
      tabWrap.addEventListener("focusin", () => { hasFocusInside = true; updateAuto() });
      tabWrap.addEventListener("focusout", e => {
        if (!e.relatedTarget || !tabWrap.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
          hasFocusInside = false;
          updateAuto()
        }
      });

      new IntersectionObserver(e => {
        inView = e[0].isIntersecting;
        updateAuto();
      }, { threshold: 0 }).observe(tabWrap);
    }

    if (convertAccordion) {
      initViewportCheck();

      let resizeTimer;
      window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(initViewportCheck, 250);
      });
    }

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
 document.querySelectorAll(".tabs_wrap").forEach((tabWrap, componentIndex) => {
 if (tabWrap.dataset.scriptInitialized) return;
 tabWrap.dataset.scriptInitialized = "true";

 // Configuration
 let loopControls = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-loop-controls") === "true",
 slideTabs = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-slide-tabs") === "true",
 autoplay = Number(tabWrap.getAttribute("data-autoplay-duration")) || 0,
 duration = Number(tabWrap.getAttribute("data-duration")) || 0.3,
 convertAccordion = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-convert-accordion") === "true",
 allowMultiple = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-allow-multiple") === "true",
 buttonList = tabWrap.querySelector(".tabs_button_list"),
 panelList = tabWrap.querySelector(".tabs_content_list"),
 previousButton = tabWrap.querySelector("[data-tab='prev']"),
 nextButton = tabWrap.querySelector("[data-tab='next']"),
 animating = false,
 autoplayTl;

 // Accordion-specific variables
 const originalParent = buttonList.parentElement;
 const accordionItems = [];
 let isAccordion = false;

 function initCMSList(slot) {
 const dynList = Array.from(slot.children).find((child) => child.classList.contains(
 "w-dyn-list"));
 if (!dynList) return;
 const nestedItems = dynList?.firstElementChild?.children;
 if (!nestedItems) return;
 const staticWrapper = [...slot.children];
 [...nestedItems].forEach(el => el.firstElementChild && slot.appendChild(el
 .firstElementChild));
 staticWrapper.forEach((el) => el.remove());
 }
 initCMSList(buttonList);
 initCMSList(panelList);

 let buttonItems = Array.from(buttonList.children);
 let panelItems = Array.from(panelList.children);

 if (!buttonList || !panelList || !buttonItems.length || !panelItems.length) {
 console.warn("Missing elements in:", tabWrap);
 return;
 }

 // Initialize ARIA attributes
 panelItems.forEach((panel, i) => {
 panel.style.display = "none";
 panel.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
 });
 buttonItems.forEach((button, i) => {
 button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
 });

 panelList.removeAttribute("role");
 buttonList.setAttribute("role", "tablist");

 let activeIndex = 0;

 // Tab functionality (original makeActive)
 const initTabActive = (index, focus = false, animate = true, pause = true) => {
 if (animating || isAccordion) return;

 buttonItems.forEach((btn, i) => {
 btn.classList.toggle("is-active", i === index);
 btn.setAttribute("aria-selected", i === index ? "true" : "false");
 btn.setAttribute("tabindex", i === index ? "0" : "-1");
 });
 panelItems.forEach((panel, i) => panel.classList.toggle("is-active", i === index));

 if (typeof ScrollTrigger !== "undefined") ScrollTrigger.refresh();
 if (nextButton) nextButton.disabled = index === buttonItems.length - 1 && !
 loopControls;
 if (previousButton) previousButton.disabled = index === 0 && !loopControls;
 if (focus) buttonItems[index].focus();

 const previousPanel = panelItems[activeIndex];
 const currentPanel = panelItems[index];
 let direction = 1;
 if (activeIndex > index) direction = -1;

 // GSAP animations
 if (typeof gsap !== "undefined" && animate && activeIndex !== index) {
 if (autoplayTl && typeof autoplayTl.restart === "function") {
 autoplayTl.restart();
 if (pause) {
 autoplayTl.progress(0);
 autoplayTl.pause();
 gsap.set(tabWrap, { "--progress": 1 });
 }
 }
 animating = true;
 let tl = gsap.timeline({
 onComplete: () => animating = false,
 defaults: { duration: duration, ease: "power1.out" }
 });

 if (slideTabs) {
 tl.set(currentPanel, { display: "block", position: "relative" });
 if (previousPanel) tl.set(previousPanel, { position: "absolute", top: 0,
 left: 0, width: "100%" });
 if (previousPanel) tl.fromTo(previousPanel, { xPercent: 0 }, { xPercent: -120 *
 direction });
 tl.fromTo(currentPanel, { xPercent: 120 * direction }, { xPercent: 0 }, "<");
 if (previousPanel) tl.set(previousPanel, { display: "none" });
 } else {
 if (previousPanel) tl.to(previousPanel, { opacity: 0 });
 if (previousPanel) tl.set(previousPanel, { display: "none" });
 tl.set(currentPanel, { display: "block" });
 tl.fromTo(currentPanel, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 });
 }
 } else {
 if (previousPanel) previousPanel.style.display = "none";
 if (currentPanel) currentPanel.style.display = "block";
 }

 buttonList.scrollTo({ left: buttonItems[index].offsetLeft, behavior: 'smooth' });
 activeIndex = index;
 };

 // Accordion toggle functionality
 const initAccordionToggle = (index) => {
 const button = buttonItems[index];
 const panel = panelItems[index];
 const isActive = button.classList.contains("is-active");

 if (!allowMultiple) {
 // Close all others
 buttonItems.forEach((btn, i) => {
 if (i !== index) {
 btn.classList.remove("is-active");
 btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
 panelItems[i].classList.remove("is-active");
 }
 });

 button.classList.toggle("is-active");
 panel.classList.toggle("is-active");
 button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", !isActive);

 };

 const initAccordionTransform = () => {
 if (isAccordion) return;
 isAccordion = true;
 tabWrap.classList.add("is-accordion");

 // Pause autoplay when in accordion mode
 if (autoplayTl) {
 autoplayTl.pause();
 gsap.set(tabWrap, { "--progress": 1 });
 }

 // Create accordion structure
 buttonItems.forEach((button, index) => {
 const panel = panelItems[index];
 const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
 wrapper.className = "accordion_item";

 // Create inner wrapper for content padding
 const contentInner = document.createElement("div");
 contentInner.className = "accordion_content_inner";

 // Move panel content to inner wrapper
 while (panel.firstChild) {
 contentInner.appendChild(panel.firstChild);
 }
 panel.appendChild(contentInner);

 // Clear all inline styles that might interfere
 panel.style.display = "";
 panel.style.opacity = "";
 panel.style.position = "";
 panel.style.transform = "";

 // Ensure proper active state for accordion
 const isCurrentlyActive = index === activeIndex;
 button.classList.toggle("is-active", isCurrentlyActive);
 panel.classList.toggle("is-active", isCurrentlyActive);

 // Update ARIA for accordion
 button.setAttribute("role", "button");
 button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", isCurrentlyActive ? "true" : "false");
 button.removeAttribute("aria-selected");
 button.removeAttribute("tabindex");
 panel.removeAttribute("role");

 // Move elements to wrapper
 wrapper.appendChild(button);
 wrapper.appendChild(panel);
 accordionItems.push(wrapper);

 // Insert wrapper in original button list location
 if (index === 0) {
 originalParent.appendChild(wrapper);
 } else {
 accordionItems[index - 1].after(wrapper);
 }
 });

 // Hide original containers
 buttonList.style.display = "none";
 panelList.style.display = "none";

 // Force ScrollTrigger refresh if available
 if (typeof ScrollTrigger !== "undefined") ScrollTrigger.refresh();
 };

 // Transform back to tabs
 const initTabsTransform = () => {
 if (!isAccordion) return;
 isAccordion = false;
 tabWrap.classList.remove("is-accordion");

 // Store current active states
 const activeStates = buttonItems.map(btn => btn.classList.contains("is-active"));
 const firstActiveIndex = activeStates.findIndex(state => state);
 if (firstActiveIndex !== -1) activeIndex = firstActiveIndex;

 // Restore tab structure
 accordionItems.forEach((wrapper, index) => {
 const button = buttonItems[index];
 const panel = panelItems[index];
 const contentInner = panel.querySelector(".accordion_content_inner");

 // Move content back from inner wrapper
 if (contentInner) {
 while (contentInner.firstChild) {
 panel.appendChild(contentInner.firstChild);
 }
 contentInner.remove();
 }

 // Reset panel styles
 panel.style.display = "none";

 // Update ARIA for tabs
 button.setAttribute("role", "tab");
 button.setAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
 button.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
 button.removeAttribute("aria-expanded");
 panel.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");

 // Move elements back
 buttonList.appendChild(button);
 panelList.appendChild(panel);

 // Remove wrapper
 wrapper.remove();
 });

 // Clear accordion items array
 accordionItems.length = 0;

 // Restore containers
 buttonList.style.display = "";
 panelList.style.display = "";

 // Re-initialize tab state properly
 animating = false; // Reset animation flag
 initTabActive(activeIndex, false, false);

 // Restart autoplay if needed
 if (autoplayTl && autoplay !== 0 && !isAccordion) {
 autoplayTl.play();
 }
 };

 // Check viewport and transform
 const initViewportCheck = () => {
 if (!convertAccordion) return;

 const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
 if (isMobile && !isAccordion) {
 initAccordionTransform();
 } else if (!isMobile && isAccordion) {
 initTabsTransform();
 }
 };

 // Initialize tabs
 initTabActive(0, false, false);

 // Update index helper
 const updateIndex = (delta, focus = false, pause = true) => {
 initTabActive((activeIndex + delta + buttonItems.length) % buttonItems.length,
 focus, true, pause);
 };

 // Navigation buttons
 nextButton?.addEventListener("click", () => updateIndex(1));
 previousButton?.addEventListener("click", () => updateIndex(-1));

 // Setup button events and IDs
 buttonItems.forEach((btn, index) => {
 let tabId = tabWrap.getAttribute("data-tab-component-id");
 tabId = tabId ? tabId.toLowerCase().replaceAll(" ", "-") : componentIndex + 1;
 let itemId = btn.getAttribute("data-tab-item-id");
 itemId = itemId ? itemId.toLowerCase().replaceAll(" ", "-") : index + 1;

 btn.setAttribute("id", "tab-button-" + tabId + "-" + itemId);
 btn.setAttribute("aria-controls", "tab-panel-" + tabId + "-" + itemId);
 panelItems[index].setAttribute("id", "tab-panel-" + tabId + "-" + itemId);
 panelItems[index].setAttribute("aria-labelledby", btn.id);

 // Handle URL parameters
 if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("tab-id") === tabId + "-" + itemId) {
 initTabActive(index);
 autoplay = 0;
 tabWrap.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
 history.replaceState({}, "", ((u) => (u.searchParams.delete("tab-id"), u))(
 new URL(location.href)));
 }

 // Click handler for both tabs and accordion
 btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
 if (isAccordion) {
 initAccordionToggle(index);
 } else {
 initTabActive(index);
 }
 });

 // Keyboard navigation
 btn.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
 if (isAccordion) {
 if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
 e.preventDefault();
 initAccordionToggle(index);
 }
 } else {
 if (["ArrowRight", "ArrowDown"].includes(e.key)) updateIndex(1, true);
 else if (["ArrowLeft", "ArrowUp"].includes(e.key)) updateIndex(-1, true);
 }
 });
 });

 // Initialize autoplay
 if (autoplay !== 0 && typeof gsap !== "undefined") {
 autoplayTl = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1 })
 .fromTo(tabWrap, { "--progress": 0 }, {
 onComplete: () => updateIndex(1, false, false),
 "--progress": 1,
 ease: "none",
 duration: autoplay
 });

 let isHovered = false,
 hasFocusInside = false,
 prefersReducedMotion = false,
 inView = true;

 function updateAuto() {
 if (prefersReducedMotion || !inView || isHovered || hasFocusInside || isAccordion) {
 autoplayTl.pause();
 } else {
 autoplayTl.play();
 }
 }

 function handleMotionChange(e) {
 prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
 updateAuto();
 }

 handleMotionChange(window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)"));
 window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").addEventListener("change",
 handleMotionChange);

 tabWrap.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => { isHovered = true;
 updateAuto() });
 tabWrap.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { hasFocusInside = false;
 isHovered = false;
 updateAuto() });
 tabWrap.addEventListener("focusin", () => { hasFocusInside = true;
 updateAuto() });
 tabWrap.addEventListener("focusout", e => {
 if (!e.relatedTarget || !tabWrap.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
 hasFocusInside = false;
 updateAuto()
 }
 });

 new IntersectionObserver(e => {
 inView = e[0].isIntersecting;
 updateAuto();
 }, { threshold: 0 }).observe(tabWrap);
 }

 // Initialize viewport check and add resize listener
 if (convertAccordion) {
 initViewportCheck();

 let resizeTimer;
 window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
 clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
 resizeTimer = setTimeout(initViewportCheck, 250);
 });
 }
 });
});

function initDropdown() {
  const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropdown="component"]');
  let currentOpenDropdown = null;
  let currentOpenButton = null;

  function closeDropdown(dropdown, button) {
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    dropdown.setAttribute('data-dropdown-open', 'false');
    if (currentOpenDropdown === dropdown) {
      currentOpenDropdown = null;
      currentOpenButton = null;
    }
  }

  function openDropdown(dropdown, button) {
    if (currentOpenDropdown && currentOpenDropdown !== dropdown) {
      closeDropdown(currentOpenDropdown, currentOpenButton);
    }
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    dropdown.setAttribute('data-dropdown-open', 'true');
    currentOpenDropdown = dropdown;
    currentOpenButton = button;
  }

  dropdowns.forEach((dropdown, index) => {
    const button = dropdown.querySelector('[data-dropdown="button"]');
    const list = dropdown.querySelector('[data-dropdown="list"]');
    const buttonText = button.querySelector('[data-button-text]');

    const closeOnSelect = dropdown.getAttribute('data-dropdown-close') === 'true';
    const openOnHover = dropdown.getAttribute('data-dropdown-hover') === 'true';

    // Set unique IDs and ARIA attributes
    const dropdownId = `dropdown-list-${index}`;
    const buttonId = `dropdown-button-${index}`;

    list.setAttribute('id', dropdownId);
    button.setAttribute('id', buttonId);
    button.setAttribute('aria-controls', dropdownId);
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    button.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'true');
    list.setAttribute('role', 'group');
    list.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', buttonId);

    let hoverTimeout;
    let focusedIndex = -1;

    const options = Array.from(dropdown.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-list_item'));

    button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const isOpen = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      if (isOpen) {
        closeDropdown(dropdown, button);
        button.focus();
      } else {
        openDropdown(dropdown, button);
      }
    });

    if (openOnHover) {
      dropdown.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
        openDropdown(dropdown, button);
      });

      dropdown.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
          closeDropdown(dropdown, button);
          button.focus();
        }, 300);
      });
    }

    // Keyboard navigation on button
    button.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      const isOpen = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!isOpen) openDropdown(dropdown, button);
        focusedIndex = 0;
        focusOption(options, focusedIndex);
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!isOpen) openDropdown(dropdown, button);
        focusedIndex = options.length - 1;
        focusOption(options, focusedIndex);
      }
    });

    // Keyboard navigation on list
    list.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        focusedIndex = (focusedIndex + 1) % options.length;
        focusOption(options, focusedIndex);
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        focusedIndex = focusedIndex <= 0 ? options.length - 1 : focusedIndex - 1;
        focusOption(options, focusedIndex);
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const radio = options[focusedIndex]?.querySelector('input[type="radio"]');
        if (radio) {
          radio.checked = true;
          radio.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeDropdown(dropdown, button);
        button.focus();
      }
    });

    function focusOption(options, index) {
      if (options[index]) {
        const radio = options[index].querySelector('input[type="radio"]');
        const label = options[index].querySelector('label');
        if (radio) radio.focus();
        else if (label) label.focus();
      }
    }

    // Event delegation — catches radios moved in after init
    list.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const radio = e.target.closest('.filter_checkbox')?.querySelector('input[type="radio"]');
      if (!radio) return;

      const selectedValue = radio.getAttribute('fs-list-value');
      if (buttonText) {
        buttonText.textContent = selectedValue || 'Select Integration';
      }

      if (closeOnSelect) {
        closeDropdown(dropdown, button);
        button.focus();
      }
    });
  });

  // Click-outside listener
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (currentOpenDropdown && !currentOpenDropdown.contains(e.target)) {
      const buttonToFocus = currentOpenButton;
      closeDropdown(currentOpenDropdown, currentOpenButton);
      if (buttonToFocus) buttonToFocus.focus();
    }
  });

  // Escape key listener
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && currentOpenDropdown) {
      const buttonToFocus = currentOpenButton;

<script>
function initSearchExpand() {
  const searchBtn = document.querySelector('.g_button_wrap.search');
  const searchWrap = document.querySelector('.search-enable');
  const searchInput = document.querySelector('.filter_search-input.is-nav');
  const searchForm = searchWrap.querySelector('.search-input_wrap');

  if (!searchBtn || !searchWrap || !searchInput) return;

  // Reset state on load
  searchWrap.classList.remove('is-expanded');
  searchInput.value = '';

  let isExpanded = false;

  searchBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!isExpanded) {
      // First click - expand
      searchWrap.classList.add('is-expanded');
      searchInput.focus();
      isExpanded = true;
    } else {
      // Second click - submit if has value
      if (searchInput.value.trim()) {
        searchForm.submit();
      }
    }
  });

  // Close on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!searchWrap.contains(e.target)) {
      searchWrap.classList.remove('is-expanded');
      isExpanded = false;
    }
  });

  // Submit on Enter key
  searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && this.value.trim()) {
      searchForm.submit();
    }
  });
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSearchExpand);
} else {
  initSearchExpand();
}
</script>

<script>
function initDropdownClearState() {
  const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropdown="list"]');
  
  dropdowns.forEach(dropdown => {
    const clearLabel = dropdown.querySelector('[data-cms-list="all"]');
    if (!clearLabel) return;
    
    const clearInput = clearLabel.querySelector('input');
    const filterInputs = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.filter_tags_cms_item input');
    const isRadio = filterInputs[0]?.type === 'radio';
    
    filterInputs.forEach(input => {
      input.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (isRadio) {
          // Radio: any selection deactivates "All"
          if (input.checked) {
            clearLabel.classList.remove('is-active');
            if (clearInput) clearInput.checked = false;
          }
        } else {
          // Checkbox: check if any filter is active
          const anyChecked = [...filterInputs].some(i => i.checked);
          if (anyChecked) {
            clearLabel.classList.remove('is-active');
            if (clearInput) clearInput.checked = false;
          } else {
            // All unchecked - restore "All" state
            clearLabel.classList.add('is-active');
            if (clearInput) clearInput.checked = true;
          }
        }
      });
    });
    
    // When "All" is clicked
    if (clearInput) {
      clearInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (clearInput.checked) {
          clearLabel.classList.add('is-active');
        }
      });
    }
  });
}

<script>
function initSecureBlankLinks() {
  const links = document.querySelectorAll('a[target="_blank"]');
  
  links.forEach(link => {
    const existingRel = link.getAttribute('rel') || '';
    const relValues = new Set(existingRel.split(' ').filter(Boolean));
    
    // Always add noopener for security
    relValues.add('noopener');
    
    // Only hide referrer for external links
    if (link.hostname !== window.location.hostname) {
      relValues.add('noreferrer');
    }
    
    link.setAttribute('rel', [...relValues].join(' '));
  });
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSecureBlankLinks);
</script>

<script>
function initCodeCopy() {
  const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('.w-richtext pre');
  if (!blocks.length) return;

  const ICON_COPY =
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' +
    '<rect x="5.5" y="5.5" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5"/>' +
    '<path d="M10.5 5.5V3.5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1h-6a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v6a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h2"/>' +
    '</svg>';
  const ICON_DONE =
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' +
    '<path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7"/>' +
    '</svg>';

  // Normalise the text we put on the clipboard: strip zero-width joiners
  // (Google Docs paste artefacts), turn NBSP into spaces, trim trailing
  // whitespace per line and drop the final newline.
  function getCodeText(pre) {
    return pre.textContent
      .replace(/[\u200D\u200B\uFEFF]/g, '')
      .replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ')
      .split('\n')
      .map((line) => line.replace(/\s+$/, ''))
      .join('\n')
      .replace(/^\n+|\n+$/g, '');
  }

  function copyText(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    }
    // Fallback for older browsers / insecure contexts
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.value = text;
      ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
      ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none';
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      try {
        document.execCommand('copy') ? resolve() : reject(new Error('execCommand failed'));
      } catch (err) {
        reject(err);
      } finally {
        ta.remove();
      }
    });
  }

  blocks.forEach((pre) => {
    // Skip if already enhanced
    if (pre.parentElement.classList.contains('code-block-wrap')) return;

    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'code-block-wrap';
    pre.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, pre);
    wrap.appendChild(pre);

    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'code-copy';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy code to clipboard');
    btn.innerHTML = ICON_COPY + '<span class="code-copy_label">Copy</span>';
    wrap.appendChild(btn);

    // Live region so screen readers announce the result
    const status = document.createElement('span');
    status.className = 'code-copy_status';
    status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    status.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    wrap.appendChild(status);

    let resetTimer = null;

    function setState(state, label) {
      clearTimeout(resetTimer);
      btn.classList.remove('is-copied', 'is-error');
      if (state) btn.classList.add(state);
      btn.innerHTML = (state === 'is-copied' ? ICON_DONE : ICON_COPY) + '<span class="code-copy_label">' + label + '</span>';
      status.textContent = state ? label : '';
      if (state) {
        resetTimer = setTimeout(() => setState(null, 'Copy'), 2000);
      }
    }

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      copyText(getCodeText(pre))
        .then(() => setState('is-copied', 'Copied'))
        .catch(() => setState('is-error', 'Failed'));
    });
  });
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initCodeCopy);
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  var API = 'https://email-gate.miscreants.dev/check';
  var TIMEOUT_MS = 2500;

  // Instant, offline first pass so the common cases never wait on the network.
  var LOCAL = {};
  ('gmail.com googlemail.com yahoo.com yahoo.co.uk hotmail.com hotmail.co.uk outlook.com live.com ' +
   'aol.com msn.com icloud.com me.com mail.com 163.com qq.com yandex.com yandex.ru proton.me ' +
   'protonmail.com pm.me gmx.com gmx.de web.de mail.ru ymail.com example.com')
    .split(' ').forEach(function (d) { LOCAL[d] = true; });

  var MESSAGES = {
    free_email:     'Please use your work email address.',
    disposable:     'Disposable email addresses aren’t accepted. Please use your work email.',
    no_such_domain: 'That email domain doesn’t exist. Please check for typos.',
    no_mx:          'That email domain doesn’t receive mail. Please check for typos.',
    override_block: 'Please use your work email address.',
    invalid_syntax: 'Please enter a valid email address.'
  };

  var cache = {}; // email → { allow, reason }

  function localCheck(email) {
    var domain = email.split('@')[1];
    if (!domain) return null;
    var parts = domain.split('.');
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
      if (LOCAL[parts.slice(i).join('.')]) return { allow: false, reason: 'free_email' };
    }
    return null;
  }

  function remoteCheck(email) {
    var ctrl = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' ? new AbortController() : null;
    var timer = ctrl && setTimeout(function () { ctrl.abort(); }, TIMEOUT_MS);
    return fetch(API, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email: email }),
      signal: ctrl ? ctrl.signal : undefined,
      keepalive: true
    })
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : { allow: true, reason: 'api_error' }; })
      .catch(function () { return { allow: true, reason: 'api_unreachable' }; })
      .then(function (res) { if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); return res; });
  }

  function attach(form) {
    var busy = false;

    form.onValidate(function () {
      var email = String(form.vals().Email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!email) return; // Marketo's own required-field validation handles empties

      var verdict = cache[email] || localCheck(email);
      if (verdict) { apply(verdict); return; }

      if (busy) { form.submittable(false); return; }
      busy = true;
      form.submittable(false);
      setButton(true);

      remoteCheck(email).then(function (res) {
        busy = false;
        setButton(false);
        cache[email] = res;
        if (res.allow) {
          form.submittable(true);
          form.submit(); // re-enters onValidate → cache hit → proceeds
        } else {
          apply(res);
        }
      });
    });

    function apply(verdict) {
      if (verdict.allow) { form.submittable(true); return; }
      form.submittable(false);
      var $email = form.getFormElem().find('#Email');
      form.showErrorMessage(MESSAGES[verdict.reason] || MESSAGES.free_email, $email);
      if (window.dataLayer) {
        window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'email_gate_block', gate_reason: verdict.reason });
      }
    }

    function setButton(waiting) {
      var btn = form.getFormElem()[0].querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
      if (!btn) return;
      if (waiting) {
        btn.setAttribute('data-gate-label', btn.textContent);
        btn.textContent = 'Checking…';
        btn.disabled = true;
      } else {
        btn.textContent = btn.getAttribute('data-gate-label') || btn.textContent;
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    }
  }

  (function wait(n) {
    if (window.MktoForms2) { MktoForms2.whenReady(attach); return; }
    if (n < 200) setTimeout(function () { wait(n + 1); }, 100); // give up after ~20 s
  })(0);
})();
</script><!-- Finsweet Attributes -->

<script>
function initBunnyPlayerBackground() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-bunny-background-init]').forEach(function(player) {
    var src = player.getAttribute('data-player-src');
    if (!src) return;

    var video = player.querySelector('video');
    if (!video) return;

    try { video.pause(); } catch(_) {}
    try { video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load(); } catch(_) {}

    // Attribute helpers
    function setStatus(s) {
      if (player.getAttribute('data-player-status') !== s) {
        player.setAttribute('data-player-status', s);
      }
    }
    function setActivated(v) { player.setAttribute('data-player-activated', v ? 'true' : 'false'); }
    if (!player.hasAttribute('data-player-activated')) setActivated(false);

    // Flags
    var lazyMode   = player.getAttribute('data-player-lazy'); // "true" | "false" (no meta)
    var isLazyTrue = lazyMode === 'true';
    var autoplay   = player.getAttribute('data-player-autoplay') === 'true';
    var initialMuted = player.getAttribute('data-player-muted') === 'true';

    // Used to suppress 'ready' flicker when user just pressed play in lazy modes
    var pendingPlay = false;

    // Autoplay forces muted + loop; IO will drive play/pause
    if (autoplay) { video.muted = true; video.loop = true; }
    else { video.muted = initialMuted; }

    video.setAttribute('muted', '');
    video.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
    video.setAttribute('webkit-playsinline', '');
    player.setAttribute('data-player-muted', video.muted ? 'true' : 'false');
    video.playsInline = true;
    if (typeof video.disableRemotePlayback !== 'undefined') video.disableRemotePlayback = true;
    if (autoplay) video.autoplay = false;

    var isSafariNative = !!video.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl');
    var canUseHlsJs    = !!(window.Hls && Hls.isSupported()) && !isSafariNative;

    // Attach media only once (for actual playback)
    var isAttached = false;
    var userInteracted = false;
    var lastPauseBy = ''; // 'io' | 'manual' | ''
    function attachMediaOnce() {
      if (isAttached) return;
      isAttached = true;

      if (player._hls) { try { player._hls.destroy(); } catch(_) {} player._hls = null; }

      if (isSafariNative) {
        video.preload = isLazyTrue ? 'none' : 'auto';
        video.src = src;
        video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function() {
          readyIfIdle(player, pendingPlay);
        }, { once: true });
      } else if (canUseHlsJs) {
        var hls = new Hls({ maxBufferLength: 10 });
        hls.attachMedia(video);
        hls.on(Hls.Events.MEDIA_ATTACHED, function() { hls.loadSource(src); });
        hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, function() {
          readyIfIdle(player, pendingPlay);
        });
        player._hls = hls;
      } else {
        video.src = src;
      }
    }

    // Initialize based on lazy mode
    if (isLazyTrue) {
      video.preload = 'none';
    } else {
      attachMediaOnce();
    }

    // Toggle play/pause
    function togglePlay() {
      userInteracted = true;
      if (video.paused || video.ended) {
        if (isLazyTrue && !isAttached) attachMediaOnce();
        pendingPlay = true;
        lastPauseBy = '';
        setStatus('loading');
        safePlay(video);
      } else {
        lastPauseBy = 'manual';
        video.pause();
      }
    }

    // Toggle mute
    function toggleMute() {
      video.muted = !video.muted;
      if (video.muted) {
        video.setAttribute('muted', '');
      } else {
        video.removeAttribute('muted');
      }
      player.setAttribute('data-player-muted', video.muted ? 'true' : 'false');
      var muteBtn = player.querySelector('[data-player-control="mute"]');
      if (muteBtn) muteBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', video.muted ? 'true' : 'false');
    }

    // Controls (delegated)
    player.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var btn = e.target.closest('[data-player-control]');
      if (!btn || !player.contains(btn)) return;
      var type = btn.getAttribute('data-player-control');
      if (type === 'play' || type === 'pause' || type === 'playpause') togglePlay();
      else if (type === 'mute') toggleMute();
    });

    // Media event wiring
    video.addEventListener('play', function() { setActivated(true); setStatus('playing'); });
    video.addEventListener('playing', function() { pendingPlay = false; setStatus('playing'); });
    video.addEventListener('pause', function() { pendingPlay = false; setStatus('paused'); });
    video.addEventListener('waiting', function() { setStatus('loading'); });
    video.addEventListener('canplay', function() { readyIfIdle(player, pendingPlay); });
    video.addEventListener('ended', function() { pendingPlay = false; setStatus('paused'); setActivated(false); });

    // In-view auto play/pause (only when autoplay is true)
    if (autoplay) {
      if (player._io) { try { player._io.disconnect(); } catch(_) {} }
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
        entries.forEach(function(entry) {
          var inView = entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0;
          if (inView) {
            if (isLazyTrue && !isAttached) attachMediaOnce();
            if ((lastPauseBy === 'io') || (video.paused && lastPauseBy !== 'manual')) {
              setStatus('loading');
              if (video.paused) togglePlay();
              lastPauseBy = '';
            }
          } else {
            if (!video.paused && !video.ended) {
              lastPauseBy = 'io';
              video.pause();
            }
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.1 });
      io.observe(player);
      player._io = io;
    }
  });

  // Helper: Ready status guard
  function readyIfIdle(player, pendingPlay) {
    if (!pendingPlay &&
        player.getAttribute('data-player-activated') !== 'true' &&
        player.getAttribute('data-player-status') === 'idle') {
      player.setAttribute('data-player-status', 'ready');
    }
  }

  // Helper: safe programmatic play
  function safePlay(video) {
    var p = video.play();
    if (p && typeof p.then === 'function') p.catch(function(){});
  }
}

// Initialize Bunny HTML HLS Player (Background)
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  initBunnyPlayerBackground();
});
</script>
